name: at-job-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: queues a one-shot at(1) job that runs a planted payload at a chosen future time. Idempotent: skips if a queued job already references the payload. Vars: PAYLOAD_PATH (required), PAYLOAD_BODY (optional single sh line), WHEN (optional at(1) time spec, default '-t 209912312359' -- a far-future absolute time). Never use a short relative WHEN such as 'now + 3 days' for a box that will be sealed into a template: the job fires, at(1) deletes it, and the paired 'queue is empty' check then passes for free on every clone sealed after that offset.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${PAYLOAD_PATH:?PAYLOAD_PATH is required}"

install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$PAYLOAD_PATH")"
printf '#!/bin/sh\n%s\n' "${PAYLOAD_BODY-}" > "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
chmod 0755 "$PAYLOAD_PATH"

queued=0
for j in $(atq 2>/dev/null | cut -f1); do
    if at -c "$j" 2>/dev/null | grep -Fq -- "$PAYLOAD_PATH"; then
        queued=1
        break
    fi
done
if [ "$queued" = "0" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$PAYLOAD_PATH" | at ${WHEN:--t 209912312359} >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
